proposal.root_cause: Commit 9aa3fd51cb58bd72b412780daaf3a1b1bedee7fe set the worker container image to the nonexistent tag python:3.12-alpine3.99, causing ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff on the new ReplicaSet worker-5b575b8d6f.
proposal.rationale: Pod worker-5b575b8d6f-7vj4q is stuck Pending with ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff because image "python:3.12-alpine3.99" does not exist on docker.io (events: "failed to resolve reference ... not found"). git_diff of commit 9aa3fd51cb58bd72b412780daaf3a1b1bedee7fe ("chore(demo): update worker.yaml", 2026-11-16T21:43:12) shows it changed the worker image from python:3.12-alpine to python:3.12-alpine3.99, matching the ReplicaSet rollout at 21:43:15. The previous ReplicaSet worker-65d89fdfc8 runs successfully on python:3.12-alpine, confirming the valid tag. Reverting the tag to python:3.12-alpine restores the last known good value.
proposal.verify: After Argo CD syncs the reverted deploy/demo/worker.yaml, a new worker ReplicaSet/pod should pull python:3.12-alpine successfully and reach Running/Ready 1/1 with 0 restarts; no ErrImagePull or ImagePullBackOff events on the new pod.
